print(Counter(x for r in test for x in r))
print(Counter(x for r in demo_in for x in r))
# count-priority overlay
def f2(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    out=[]
    for r in range(3):
        row=[]
        for c in range(6):
            cells=[g[r+3*b][c] for b in range(4)]
            nz=[v for v in cells if v]
            row.append(max(nz,key=lambda v:cnt[v]) if nz else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
assert f2(demo_in)==demo_out
import json; print(json.dumps(f2(test)))
# also check where f2 differs from first-nonzero
def f1(g):
    return [[next((g[r+3*b][c] for b in range(4) if g[r+3*b][c]),0) for c in range(6)] for r in range(3)]
